Headline: Quote win rate jumped to a new high
Text: 53% of quotes were won, up 13 pts on last week and the best week in the last 12.

Headline: Afternoon enquiries are left waiting
Text: 79% of weekday enquiries arriving after 3pm waited over 4 hrs for a reply, against 9% earlier in the day. Quotes answered fast win far more.

Headline: Name someone to own the inbox
Text: Roster one person to clear new enquiries before knocking off each day, and to own the inbox on Mondays, when first replies take 3.0 hrs.
